name: EB-2 (I-140, PERM or NIW)
summary: Second-preference employment petition for an advanced-degree professional or person of exceptional ability, with a labor certification (PERM) or a National Interest Waiver.

forms.title: Appendix A (NIW)
forms.note: Signed by petitioner and beneficiary per USCIS I-140 checklist (11/06/2024). Not auto-filled.

forms.title: Application to Adjust Status
forms.note: Only if the priority date is current (Visa Bulletin).

filing.fee: See Form G-1055 at uscis.gov/g-1055 (includes Asylum Program Fee for employer petitioners where applicable).

questions.label: Date the labor certification was certified by DOL
Describe the work you will do in the U.S. (the proposed endeavor)
Why is this work important to the United States (substantial merit and national importance)?
Why are you well positioned to do it (education, track record, plan, funding, interest from others)?
Why would it benefit the U.S. to waive the job offer and labor certification?
File I-485 at the same time (if your priority date is current)?

checklist.label: Foreign degree credential evaluation
checklist.help: Needed if your degree is from outside the U.S., to show U.S. equivalency.

checklist.label: Employer letters showing experience (writer's name, address, title, and your specific duties)
checklist.help: For bachelor's + 5 years: show progressive post-degree experience. For exceptional ability: 10 years full-time.
checklist.source: I-140 Instructions 06/07/24, item 4.A(1)-(2); USCIS I-140 checklist, General Requirements

checklist.label: At least 3 of: license or certification, high salary, memberships, recognition by peers or government
Certified ETA-9089 Final Determination (original, signed)
checklist.help: Must reach USCIS within 180 days of certification.

checklist.label: Employer's ability to pay: annual reports, federal tax returns or audited financials (or CFO letter if 100+ employees)
Evidence the endeavor has substantial merit and national importance (reports, policy documents, industry data)
Evidence you are well positioned (publications, citations, patents, contracts, funding, business plan, letters of interest)
I-94 and current status documents (if in the U.S.)

coverLetter.re: Form I-140, Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers - EB-2 ({{track}})
coverLetter.request: We respectfully submit the enclosed Form I-140 for {{givenName}} {{familyName}}, a {{fieldOfEndeavor}}, seeking classification as a member of the professions holding an advanced degree or a person of exceptional ability.
points: The beneficiary qualifies for EB-2 classification: {{qualifyingBasis}}.
{{#nationalImportance}}The proposed endeavor has substantial merit and national importance.{{/nationalImportance}}
{{#wellPositioned}}The beneficiary is well positioned to advance the proposed endeavor.{{/wellPositioned}}
{{#waiverBenefit}}On balance, it would be beneficial to the United States to waive the job offer and labor certification requirements.{{/waiverBenefit}}
